text:
Tamsin Blake: Hey folks! First day at Redwood — super excited to join the Eng Platform team. Remote from Bristol (UK) but visiting SF in June. I brew terrible sourdough and excellent coffee. Hi!
Oliver K: Welcome Tamsin :wave: where in Bristol? we’ve got a few UK folks scattered about.
Tamsin Blake: Hi Oliver — Clifton area. I cycle and climb on weekends.
Maya Chen: Hi Tamsin!! :tada: rooftop meetup is the 2nd Friday — we usually grab takeout after. If you’re in SF in June we should defs meet.
Samir Goyal: welcome aboard :rocket: badge pickup is in People Ops — @People Ops can confirm slot times. Also ping #eng-platform for onboarding docs + quickstart.
People Ops: Hi Tamsin — congrats and welcome! We’ve sent your badge pickup window for Wed 10–11am PT. LMK if that conflicts and we’ll rearrange.
devex-bot: Welcome kit checklist: 1) laptop setup 2) git access 3) payroll form 4) quickstart repo. Link: https://redwood.example/bootcamp
Tamsin Blake: Thanks everyone — laptop arrived already, I’ll try to finish setup tonight. Any tips on hidden snack stashes in the SF office? :eyes:
Jamie L: There’s a secret cookie drawer on 3rd floor (do not tell facilities). Also matcha packets by the kettle.
Maya Chen: If you want a climbing partner in SF, I usually go Sat mornings. Send me a DM.
Oliver K: btw if you care about keyboard layout, folks in eng-platform use a small qmk club group — ping me and I’ll add you.
Samir Goyal: FYI we do a 1:1 welcome lightning chat for new hires — someone from Eng Platform will schedule 30 mins this week.
Tamsin Blake: Amazing, thank you all. Looking forward to meeting folks in person. Also will bring actual sourdough next time I’m in SF :bread:
Maya Chen: Omg yes please :yum:
Oliver K: Welcome again! :raised_hands:
